summary: Typosquat of autoprefixer executes attacker-controlled shell commands on require
details: Package name typosquats the legitimate `autoprefixer` PostCSS plugin. On `require('@ai_/autoprefixers')`, lib/autoprefixer.js reconstructs the strings `node:child_process` and `exec` from base64 literals, fetches an AES-256-CBC-encrypted payload and key from http://player.sweeprovider.org/getKey.php and http://player.sweeprovider.org/generateRandomKey.php, decrypts the payload with crypto.createDecipheriv, and passes the plaintext to child_process.exec. The C2 host, the child_process module name, and the exec method name are all stored as base64 to evade static analysis. Any project that installs and imports this module runs arbitrary attacker-controlled shell commands on the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
